parameters.description: 'Safe For Work'. This is a flag. When supplied it will filter out entries according to the SFW Policy. You do not need to pass a value to it. e.g usage: `?sfw`
parameters.name: sfw

parameters.description: This is a flag. When supplied it will include entries which are unapproved. Unapproved entries on MyAnimeList are those that are user submitted and have not yet been approved by MAL to show up on other pages. They will have their own specifc pages and are often removed resulting in a 404 error. You do not need to pass a value to it. e.g usage: `?unapproved`
parameters.name: unapproved

parameters.description:
This is a flag. When supplied it will include entries which are continuing from previous seasons. MAL includes these items on the seasons view in the ″TV (continuing)″ section. (Example: https://myanimelist.net/anime/season/2024/winter)
Example usage: `?continuing`
parameters.name: continuing

approved.description: Whether the entry is pending approval on MAL or not

favorites.description: Number of users who have favorited this entry

members.description: Number of users who have added this entry to their list

400.description: Error: Bad request. When required parameters were not supplied.
